programme.desc: Hoje é o último dia da vida do assassino Chev Chelios. Um veneno o matará se seu coração voltar ao ritmo normal. Para permanecer vivo e se vingar, Chev deve manter sua adrenalina elevada de qualquer maneira possível.

programme.title: Amanhecer Negro
programme.desc: Um ex-policial tenta descobrir a verdade por trás do sequestro de um banqueiro americano, com a ajuda da única testemunha sobrevivente.

programme.title: Cadê a Minha Entrega?
programme.desc: Risos, furtos, caos – uma carga de contrabando é erroneamente entregue a uma gangue de bandidos incompetentes. Astros incluem Donald Faison, Mike Epps, Mos Def.

programme.title: A Grande Escolha
programme.desc: No dia de recrutamento da NFL, o gerente Sonny Weaver (Kevin Costner) tem a oportunidade de salvar o futebol americano em Cleveland quando consegue ser o primeiro a escolher entre os candidatos. Ele precisa decidir rápido o que está disposto a sacrificar em busca da perfeição, enquanto os limites entre sua vida pessoal e profissional se desfazem num dia crucial para a vida de centenas de homens com o sonho de jogar na NFL.

programme.title: If You Believe
programme.desc: Quando pequena, Suzie era extrovertida, otimista e gostava de uma travessura. Mas Suzie virou Susan, e sua personalidade brincalhona foi sumindo ao longo dos anos. Agora com 40 e poucos anos, ela se tornou uma mulher profissional meio amarga e cínica. Mal sabe ela que está prestes a receber uma visita inesperada de uma velha amiga que quer voltar atrás e se divertir no processo!

programme.title: Um Funeral em Família
programme.desc: Madea e a alegre reunião de família do grupo se torna um hilário pesadelo quando ela se vê inesperadamente organizando um funeral que pode revelar desagradáveis segredos de família.

programme.title: Um Assalto Muito Louco
programme.desc: Um policial (Dylan Walsh) e sua noiva (Brooke Shields), uma caixa de banco, planejam um assalto a banco perfeito. Tudo vai bem até que o FBI suspeita, quase imediatamente, de um empregado interno.

programme.title: Amor Sem Fim
programme.desc: David, de 17 anos, e Jade, de 15 anos, (Brooke Shields) se encontram em um apaixonado caso de amor. Mas quando seu relacionamento se intensifica, ele começa a ter consequências – e quando David é impedido de ver Jade, uma cadeia de eventos trágicos se desenrola.

programme.title: Philomena
programme.desc: An Irishwoman teams with a journalist to find the son she was forced to give up for adoption 50 years ago.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the scandal of child molestation within the Catholic Church.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: The inspiring true story of the real life 2013 Boston Marathon bombing survivor Jeff Bauman.

programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on Earth.

programme.desc: A seemingly solid marriage begins to crumble when the wife discovers her husband intends to divorce her.

programme.title: Madea Goes to Jail
programme.desc: Mischievous grandma Madea lands in jail, where she meets a variety of mixed-up characters.

programme.desc: When five single moms form a support group, they find inspiration and laughter in their new sisterhood.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: A businessman is jolted out of his scripted life when he meets a single mother who cleans his office.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's The Family That Preys
programme.desc: Two families from different walks of life learn to work together.

programme.title: Madea's Witness Protection
programme.desc: An investment banker who has been set up as the linchpin of a Ponzi scheme is relocated to Aunt Madea's home.

programme.title: For Colored Girls
programme.desc: Each actress portrays a character from a poem, revealing issues that impact women of color in particular.

programme.title: Schreiendes Unrecht
programme.desc: Ein Mordprozess endet mit dem Freispruch des Angeklagten, als sein Anwalt (Michael McKean) die Geschworenen manipuliert, indem er den Charakter des ermordeten Opfers zerstört.

programme.title: Auge des Dämons
programme.desc: Ein junges Paar zieht in eine seltsame alte Stadt und beginnt zu vermuten, dass ihre charmanten Nachbarn einem alten Hexenzirkel angehören.

programme.title: China Girl
programme.desc: Eine moderne Version von Romeo und Julia, die Geschichte eines chinesischen Mädchens und eines italienischen Jungen, deren Beziehung durch die langjährige Fehde zwischen rivalisierenden ethnischen Straßenbanden gefährdet wird.

programme.title: Dangerous Child
programme.desc: Sally Cambridge (Delta Burke) deckt die Gewaltausbrüche ihres Sohnes schnell ab und gibt sich unwissentlich als Täterin aus. Bald wird ihr Kindesmissbrauch vorgeworfen; obwohl sie diejenige ist; die missbraucht wird.

programme.title: Rhapsodie im August
programme.desc: Rhapsodie im August ist die eindrucksvolle Darstellung des nuklearen Holocausts in Nagasaki durch den japanischen Großmeister Akira Kurosawa, gesehen durch die Augen einer Überlebenden und ihrer vier Enkelkinder - 44 Jahre später.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Die Showbiz-Legende Judy Garland kommt für ihre letzten Konzerte nach London. Nachdem sie 45 ihrer 47 Jahre gearbeitet hat, wird sie von Erinnerungen an eine Kindheit in Hollywood heimgesucht und sehnt sich nach der Rückkehr zu ihren Kindern.

programme.title: Little Monsters
programme.desc: Join Brian (Fred Savage) lernt Maurice (Howie Mandell) kennen, das freundliche aber bekloppte Monster, das unter seinem Bett lebt. Maurice nimmt Brian mit in seine Welt und lehrt ihn alle Geheimnisse der kleinen Monster und dass es überall kleine Abenteuer gibt, wenn man danach Ausschau hält.

programme.title: A Kid in King Arthur's Court
programme.desc: Ein gewaltiges Erdbeben Südkalifornien trifft auch den hilflosen Teenager, Calvin Fuller (Thomas Ian Nicholas) und macht, dass er durch ein Loch, das ins Netz der Zeit gerissen ist, hindurchschlingert. Calvin erwacht im Mittelalter, wo der legendäre Zauberer Merlin (Ron Moody) ihn rekrutiert, um Camelot vom Bösen zu befreien.

programme.title: Step Up: Jahr des Tanzes
programme.desc: Junge Menschen aus verschiedenen sozialen Klassen in Peking kommen zusammen, um Chinas beste Tanztruppe zu bilden und zu lernen, was Familie wirklich bedeutet.

programme.title: Arkansas
programme.desc: Kyle (Liam Hemsworth) et Swin (Clark Duke) vivent sous les ordres d’un baron de la drogue d’Arkansas appelé Frog (Vince Vaughn). Quand une série d’erreurs les force à affronter Frog, Kyle et Swin doivent le tuer ou mourir.

programme.title: Où est l'argent
programme.desc: Un jeune homme vif d'esprit des rues de South Central doit intégrer en urgence une fraternité blanche comme neige de l'Université du Sud de la Californie pour récupérer un stock d'argent volé.

programme.title: School Dance
programme.desc: Jason, en première année de lycée, a trouvé la fille de ses rêves, mais il y a un seul problème : elle ne sait pas qu'il existe.

programme.title: Get a Job
programme.desc: Hilarante et rafraîchissante comédie sur les tribulations de la recherche d’emploi dans un contexte économique difficile. Jeunes diplômés tout juste sortis de l’université, Will (Teller) et Jillian (Kendrick) se voient rapidement confrontés aux obstacles auxquels les jeunes font face aujourd’hui sur un marché de l’emploi où la concurrence fait rage.

programme.title: Les doutes de Scarlett
programme.desc: Une jeune femme rentre de l'université et commence à avoir des doutes sur son nouveau beau-père, le partenaire de travail de son défunt père, après avoir découvert qu'il avait rendez-vous avec une femme retrouvée morte le lendemain.

programme.title: Une vie secrète
programme.desc: Sarah vivait une vie parfaite avec son mari Jason et leur fils Brandon, jusqu'à ce que Jason disparaisse. Le fils de Sarah souffre d'une maladie génétique rare et seul l'ADN de Jason peut le sauver. Quand Sarah retrouve enfin la trace de Jason, celui-ci fait en sorte que Sarah ne détruise pas sa vie secrète et ne révèle pas ses offenses passées.

programme.title: The Christmas Apprentice
programme.desc: Riley Thomas (Abigail Hawk) is a rising star at one of the world's most noted holding companies. With Christmas fast approaching, she is sent to the small town of Chestnut, Vermont to evaluate the assets of one of their companies, an outerwear clothing manufacturer. As she begins making plans for liquidation, she hires the company's founder, Nick (Howard Hesseman)-now retired-as her apprentice to help. Of course, everyone assumes she's there to save the company and she keeps her true motives a secret. In the process, she comes to appreciate what the company means to the small town; and she falls in love with its youthful CEO, Wyatt (David O'Donnell). She slowly comes to embrace the small town's values and even helps create a new product line just in time for Christmas. As her priorities change and her love grows, will Riley be able to stand up to her boss, Preston Bullock (Chevy Chase) and save the company she was supposed to destroy?

programme.desc: A struggling actress is hired to impersonate a woman for a business meeting, but soon finds her life in danger.

programme.title: Episodio 9
programme.desc: Yubiri le reclama airadamente a Briggite el robo de su logo. Y le dice que también la había admirado mucho. Cuando escuchó esto Briggite | pensó que ahora si la podía fregar. Ana y Mauricio se ponen de acuerdo para verse esa noche y llevarle una película a Carlitos Fabián y Junior están burlándose de Olegario y su nueva vivienda donde Ana y llega Clarisa. El Junior comienza a decirle cosas terminar en que Olegario se va a mudar a una pensión. Briggite convence a Yubiri con mentiras.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 182: Paco Desobligado y la Vida de Maria Antonia
programme.desc: María Antonia está muy molesta con Paco porque solamente habló al hospital para saber cómo estaba Gerson y cree que es un padre desobligado. Después de que Theo salvó la vida de María Antonia, ella confiesa que se hubiera muerto si le pasa algo a él.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 127: Betania Vuelve a Casa; Marisela y Alfredo
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo e Inés están llevando a Betania a la Casa. Todos están esperándola para recibirla. Menos Gabriela que cuando entran, ella va de salida. Luis Guillermo le recrimina que ni siquiera haya ido a visitarla a la clínica. Gabriela viendo a Robert, le dice que ya había demasiada gente en la clínica. Y se va. Marisela le pide perdón a Alfredo por no haberle dicho antes del matrimonio que ella había estado con otro hombre. Alfredo le dice que entonces menos entiende porque ella lo rechaza. Se va de la habitación a dormir en el corredor. En la mañana Rosario está comentando que esos matrimonios de ahora. Diego Andrés la escucha y pregunta porque dice eso.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rodrigo irrumpe en la casa de Virginia, amenazándola a ella y a su familia. Le ofrece un trato, ella debe entregarle unos documentos importantes y él la deja en paz. Trinidad comienza a desconfiar de Carlota, ella sabe que no es una enfermera de verdad. Mientras tanto Alejandra toma todas las medidas para hacer efectivo el traslado de Maribel a otro edificio. Adolfo regresa a la empresa y pide una oficina. Carlos Ernesto desconfía de sus intenciones, teme que quiera perjudicar a laboratorios Ferrándiz y tal y como lo sospechaba, Adolfo les informa que ha reunido las firmas necesarias para llamar a elecciones para una nueva junta directiva.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: La polic a llega a la casa para arrestar a Reina por el crimen de un hombre ocurrido hace a os. Finalmente el comisario se la lleva aun a pesar de la furia de Alejandro. Tras una charla con Raquel, Columba decide enfrentar a Jos Domingo y preguntarle si le ha sido infiel. l reacciona violentamente a sus planteos. B rbara finalmente se reencuentra con su beb y atando cabos junto a Torombolo y Giselle, se da cuenta de que l podr a ser el padre de su hijo.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene y Leonardo discuten acerca de su relación. Ella le manifiesta que se siente como un estorbo. Leo y Oriana hablan sobre el embarazo de ella. La cosa va bien hasta que Oriana menciona la palabra matrimonio. Tony escolta a Maribel fuera del edificio. Finalmente llega Juan Carlos con la que parece ser una solución al problema del traslado de Maribel. Trinidad, tiene una ácida discusión con Agustina sobre el cuadro de Rebeca. Luego, Trinidad llama a María Lucía que está con Virginia y les comenta a ambas sus temores de que se esté planeando algo en su contra en la mansión Ferrándiz. Las muchachas terminan por dar crédito a sus palabras.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Tras su segunda fuga, Heriberto Madroño acecha a Sol y a Alejandro. Está armado y llega a apuntar pero no puede asesinar a Sol. La ama demasiado. Bárbara y Giselle llegan a la conclusión de que nadie sino Reina Monserrat pudo ser responsable del secuestro del bebé. La situación entre José Domingo y Columba es insostenible. Cuando ella le cuestiona una salida, José Domingo reacciona violentamente y justo aparece Eloy. Se produce una feroz pelea entre ambos y Columba termina por irse corriendo.

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: D'après la légende, dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, des forces saxonnes venues de l'est attaquent le peuple celte. Le druide Aberthol s'y attèle aussi. Mais tout n'est pas perdu. Arthur, un guerrier banni, et Merlin, un sorcier ermite, s'unissent, tels des héros, pour sauver le peuple.

programme.title: O Homen Mais Procurado do Mundo

O grupo está atrás de pistas que possam levá-los à localização do inimigo número um dos Estados Unidos: Osama Bin Laden, considerado o mentor dos atentados terroristas ocorridos em território americano em 11 de setembro de 2001.

programme.title: Venganza al Trono
programme.desc: Una epopeya de espadas y brujería ambientada a finales del siglo XIII en Malta. Un grupo de guerreros maltrechos topa con un fuerte después de una sangrienta batalla. Los acontecimientos rápidamente se convierten en un torbellino de intriga, sexo y brutales enfrentamientos medievales.

programme.title: Balas en Furia

programme.title: Brigada Antisecuestros
programme.desc: Gabriela, una niña de once años, hija de un futbolista, es secuestrada durante el Mundial de Fútbol por un grupo de terroristas. Rafael, exdiputado de la Brigada Antisecuestros, tiene la tarea de resolver el caso y salvar a la niña de la forma más rápida y discreta posible. Durante la investigación, Rafael descubre que el grupo también pretende volar el Maracaná.

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.title: A Vilã
programme.desc: Desde pequena, Sook-hee foi treinada para se tornar uma assassina. Quando é recrutada como agente secreta, ela tem uma nova oportunidade de trabalhar por 10 anos e ganhar sua liberdade. Sua nova identidade é ser atriz de teatro. Para alguém que viveu uma vida de assassinatos, levar uma vida normal não é fácil. Mas logo eles descobrirão os segredos de seu passado.

programme.title: Sacrifício
programme.desc: Um policial infiltrado em uma rede de distribuição de heroína se envolve profundamente quando um jovem desertor do tráfico de drogas deixa sua irmã de cinco anos sob seus cuidados.

programme.title: Encuentra el amor en Valentine
programme.desc: Kennedy hereda un rancho pero el capataz la confunde con una intrusa y la relación no empieza con buen pie.

programme.title: Obsessão Perigosa
programme.desc: Um homem de meia idade em um casamento estagnado descobre que sua vida está em suspenso quando uma jovem atraente e seu marido aparentemente abusivo se mudam na porta ao lado.

programme.title: Nunca Es Tarde Para Enamorarse
programme.desc: Dustin Hoffman da vida a Harvey, un hombre que acaba de quedarse sin trabajo y que viaja a Londres para asistir a la boda de su hija. Para colmo de males, lo han alojado solo en un hotel, mientras el resto de la familia comparte una casa, y su hija quiere que sea su padrastro quien la lleve al altar. Pero conoce a Kate, una peculiar mujer que puede hacer que su viaje a Londres merezca la pena

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: El instinto de policí­a de Rachel le dice que un forastero que recien llego a su pueblo no es quien dice ser.

programme.title: Greta
programme.desc: Greta é uma adolescente rebelde e com tendências suicidas que, após o divórcio de sua mãe, é enviada para o verão com seus avós em Nova Jersey, onde sua vida é de um voo inesperado ao enamorar de um cozinheiro com um passado complicado.

programme.title: El problema con el muérdago
programme.desc: Willa Davis es propietaria de una tienda de mascotas en San Francisco. Un día se reencuentra con el chico que la dejó plantada en el instituto, y tendrá que luchar con todas sus fuerzas contra su propio corazón para no volver a enamorarse, diez años después.

programme.title: Finding Love in Big Sky, Montana
programme.desc: Una campesina independiente asume la tarea de mantener el rancho de su adorado abuelo.

programme.title: Apenas Por Uma Noite
programme.desc: O marido de uma mulher casada e com uma vida perfeita trai a irmã, com consequências extremas para todos.

programme.title: Tercera identidad
programme.desc: Años 60. Sally Cauffield (Sharon Stone) es una estadounidense casada con Leo Cauffield (Rupert Everett), un inglés que lleva una doble vida: es periodista y agente de la KGB. Cuando, tras varios años de matrimonio, Leo desaparece, Sally lo busca y cuando lo encuentra se entera de que es un espía cuyo nombre en clave es “El Tercer Hombre”.

programme.title: Nessi y Yo
programme.desc: Jamie, de nueve años, y sus nuevos amigos de la escuela deben demostrar que la mítica y dulce criatura marina del lago es real para salvar su ciudad de un magnate codicioso. Una sirena y un mapa del tesoro se suman a esta mágica aventura.

programme.title: Receitas do Amor
programme.desc: Depois de uma crítica negativa e uma palestra do chef Gordon Ramsay, um talentoso mas angustiado chef londrino transforma um pub country em um restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: Amor Sin Tiempo
programme.desc: Megan parece tener la vida perfecta: una relación amorosa con un maravilloso esposo llamado Thomas y dos adorables hijos. Luego se encuentra despertando de un coma y descubre que no está y que nunca se ha casado. Thomas y los niños parecen no existir. Sus padres se preocupan por ella y Megan lucha por dejar de lado la realidad con la que soñaba.

programme.title: Siguiendo a Mary
programme.desc: Con veintitantos y sin rumbo, Joey Vitello todavía vive en casa con su extravagante familia ítalo-estadounidense cuando se reencuentra con una compañera de escuela de la infancia, Mary O’Callahan.

programme.title: A Árvore Da Vida
programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Navidad A La Vuelta De La Esquina
programme.desc: Claire, una experta capitalista de riesgo de la ciudad, escapa a un pueblo pintoresco durante las vacaciones y se convierte en invitada de la librería Fortenbury. A su llegada, Claire descubre que las celebraciones navideñas han sido canceladas después de una inundación y la librería está en muy mal estado.

programme.title: The Bread, My Sweet
programme.desc: Un hombre le propone matrimonio a una mujer que solo ha visto una vez, todo en el mismo día.

programme.title: La promesa
programme.desc: En la Alemania de antes de la Primera Guerra Mundial, un joven se enamora de la esposa de su jefe, desatando un romance prohibido.

programme.title: Quem Quer Ser Um Milionário?
programme.desc: Um adolescente de Mumbai reflete sobre sua vida depois de ser acusado de enganar a versão indiana de "Quem quer ser um milionário?"

programme.desc: En un bar de Buenos Aires llamado Garllington se reúne a diario un grupo de amigos que rondan los 40 años.

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Duas mulheres de origens diferentes começam uma relação na década de 1950. Carol é casada, mas seu casamento está morto há muito tempo. Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Grandir dans les années 80 au sein d'une famille complétement barrée mais aimante, c'était le quotidien d'Adam, aujourd'hui trentenaire, qui se demande comment il a pu devenir si 'normal' dans de telles conditions ! A partir des vidéos qu'il a tournées pendant toute son enfance, il en retrace les événéments les plus marquants.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Grandir dans les années 80 au sein d'une famille complétement barrée mais aimante, c'était le quotidien d'Adam, aujourd'hui trentenaire, qui se demande comment il a pu devenir si 'normal' dans de telles conditions ! programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Fans inconditionnelles de Patrick Swayze, Beverly et Erica font des pieds et des mains pour que le thème de la soirée dansante du lycée soit Dirty Dancing, malgré la réticence du Principal Ball qui prétend que les danses sont trop suggestives. Ce dernier finit par céder, mais Beverly fait marche arrière lorsque la lascivité de certains déhanchés lui saute aux yeux…

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry est conscient que le père de sa petite copine le déteste. Il met en place une stratégie pour se faire apprécier de lui. Adam découvre qu'une société de vente de cassettes de musique par correspondance propose d'envoyer à domicile 12 cassettes pour seulement un centime. Mais il faut s'engager par contrat à en acheter d'autres au prix fort. Adam décide de créer de fausses identités pour bénéficier de l'offre exceptionnelle. Erica n'en peut plus que sa mère l'accuse de tous les maux. Elle décide de lui montrer à quel point elle peut mal se comporter en allant voler dans un magasin.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Alors que le titre de meilleur athlète du lycée lui passe sous le nez, Barry décide de suivre les traces de son idole « Eddie l'Aigle » et décide de choisir une discipline sportive qui lui permettra de participer aux Jeux Olympiques et de prouver qu'il est un sportif de haut niveau.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Adam et ses amis en ont assez de toujours être choisis en dernier lors des compositions d'équipes, en sport.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Barry pique une crise de jalousie quand Beverly offre le trophée du meilleur fils à Adam, une réaction qu'il finira par regretter quand il est promu favori, à son tour.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly et Lainey en ont assez de voir Barry avec le même T-shirt orange. Elles décident de simuler un accident de lessive pour s'en débarrasser.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: Beverly s'apprête à passer la plus belle des Fêtes des Mères, mais Erica et Barry ont oublié l'évènement et comme chaque année, ils lui offrent un coupon spécial câlins que Beverly a bien l'intention de mettre à profit en une seule journée.

programme.desc: La disparition d'une fille de cinq ans met au jour l'enquête en infiltration d'un reporter ambitieux sur le trafic d'immigrants clandestins en provenance de Chine.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: Jess et Nicole enquêtent sur la disparition d'une femme qui pourrait être impliquée dans un plan d'escroquerie complexe et mortel.

programme.desc: L'audition d'un gangster russe notoire avant son procès entraîne l'enlèvement d'une fille innocente.

programme.desc: Une femme affirme avoir vu son fils, qu'elle croyait mort dans un accident de voiture il y a dix ans.

programme.desc: Tandis que la perspective d'être harcelée terrifie Lulu, Nick cherche à protéger un petit garçon d'un parent abusif.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: From break up to make up, Jeff Gordon and Ray reunite to go on a quest to find their Chevrolet Monte Carlo that claimed victory in their final race together at Phoenix, AZ in 1999. John Bickford, Jeff Gordon’s stepdad, makes the call that reunites the old team. Jeff and Ray look to bum parts off their boss, Rick Hendrick, to make their vision a reality: get the car, replace the parts as they were, make it run and get it to auction.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: One of the greatest battles in NASCAR history was Hall of Famer Richie Evans and rival speedster Jerry Cook. Ray is determined to uncover and revive the cars that made these men famous.Ray purchases one of Richie’s original #61 modifieds from Jimmy Spencer and restores it to its original glory while simultaneously building a replica of Jerry Cook’s #38. Throughout the build process, Ray uncovers stories about these legends through the eyes of guys who were in Rome, NY to witness it firsthand, like Robin Pemberton and Steve Hmiel.Both cars will hit the track at Martinsville, site of one of the greatest races in modified history and the tragic death of Richie Evans himself. Legends live again, as Ray recreates one of the racing world’s most celebrated rivalries on a track that has seen it all.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.sub-title: The Fastest Man on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Horsepower and million-dollar sticker shock, from two and four wheels, dominate this edition of C & O.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A battle in the beautiful Caribbean Islands. Over 2 days and more than 10,000 spectators expected like previous editions. The cold temperature from the Iceman is changed in 35 degrees hot Martinique. Watch who gets the title in Martinique, events include: Truck Pull, Deadlift, Hercules Hold, Log Lift, and Arm Over Arm Pull.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. The strongman champions league Bosnia is another iconic Strongman event with the return of Rongo Keen from Australia and Portugal winner 2022 George Sulaiman.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Sibiu in Romania. It’s an important day for some of these athletes, because four of them have a real chance of getting into our all-exclusive world finals. There’s only one more stage after this to get those all-important extra points. So, there’s going to be some fireworks, who will take the title here and who will qualify for the World Finals?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is it the last show before the world final. These guys have really got to fight for the points now, this is going to be action packed, whilst these guys fight it out all day.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkey’s south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season of Strongman Champions League. Here in the sunshine, we’ll finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is. You could not ask for a better setting. After months of hard-work, if not years for some of these lads, we find out who will take the world title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome, to day two of the strongman champions league 2022 finals here in Alanya, Turkey. It’s all up for grabs now, everyone is fighting for the world title belt. This is an epic episode where we finally crown the World champion of 2022.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the 2023 Strongman Champions League in Vaasa, Finland! This year’s event introduces a knockout format with 6 intense events over 90 minutes, ending in a unique deadlift face-off with boats.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage 2 of the Strongman Champions League 2023 is set in Zrenjanin, Serbia. This exciting event features 5 challenging contests, including a superhuman Yoke race. As the SCL World Series Tour continues, athletes will battle it out to claim the yellow leader’s position for the season. Don’t miss this incredible stage of strength and endurance!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2023 Season 9, Stage 3 - Finland Teams World
programme.desc: The World’s Strongest Team will be crowned in this edition of SCL, here in Kalajoki-Finland we’ve picked some of the best in the business, teamed them up, and they’ll be going all out against each other. It’s now no longer about being a lonely wolf, but more about the pack mentality. It is a competition over 7 events, including a Big 2-man Log lift and heavy deadlift. Let’s start the action.

programme.title: Escandalos - Un Gato Para Sarahil
programme.desc: Una joven criada en una estricta familia, apeada a las costumbres árabes, desea tener una mascota. Roba un cheque a su padre para comprarla. Aterrada al ser descubierta trata de recuperar el dinero. En la desesperación al no lograrlo termina matando a los jóvenes que le vendieron la mascota

programme.title: Escandalos - Batalla Embriones
programme.desc: Una famosa estrella de comedias televisivas, a punto de casarse con un famoso actor de cine, se debe enfrentar a su exmarido cuando este decide convertirse en padre soltero, usando embriones que ambos congelaron durante su matrimonio.

programme.title: Prueba de Fe
programme.desc: En Lima la ciencia y la religión trabajan de la mano para revelar al mundo el verdadero rostro de Santa Rosa de Lima. Mientras tanto en un pueblo apartado una médico rural será testigo de un hecho milagroso que cambiará su vida y la de una niña que fue maltratada y encerrada, al igual que la Santa de Amêrica.

programme.title: Mi Amor en Navidad
programme.desc: LUCAS es un famoso cantante. Su tema navideño “Mi Amor en Navidad” ha sido un hit desde hace casi dos décadas. Pero ya no siente deseos de seguir interpretando esta canción. Un diciembre decide tomarse unas vacaciones para reflexionar sobre su carrera y sobre su futuro y regresa al pueblo donde creció. Allí se rencuentra con ELISA, su amor de juventud y conoce a JORGE, el hijo adolescente de ELISA, que sueña con llegar a ser músico. A través de ellos se conecta con sus raíces y sus recuerdos y consigue de nuevo esos motivos que una vez lo enamoraron de la música, de la navidad… ¡y de Elisa!

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: Amores Que Enganan
programme.desc: Mariana era una mujer profesionista e independiente, pero a raíz de su segundo matrimonio con Ricardo ella deja de trabajar y se vuelve totalmente dependiente económicamente de su esposo. Cuando esta situación pone en riesgo a sus hijos, Mariana toma fuerzas para confrontar a su marido y cambiar su vida.

programme.title: Tomame o Dejame
programme.desc: Ocurre el primer encuentro entre Adan y Lara. A lara la despinden del canal por bajos rating desde que inicio el programa de Adan

programme.title: Una Deliciosa Navidad
programme.desc: Máximo y Luciana son amantes de la cocina. Pero hasta allí llegan sus coincidencias. Él es un prestigioso chef apasionado por la comida molecular, y ella es una cocinera intuitiva empeñada en rescatar los sabores de su tierra. Cuando el destino los junta, en plena Navidad, en el restaurante que Máximo hereda de su padre y que Luciana regenta, la combinación es explosiva. Pero también deliciosa.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: El Sabor de la Navidad
programme.desc: Una pequeña empresa familiar de Rompope enfrenta una encrucijada cuando una transnacional decide cerrar sus puertas en plena temporada navideña. Gregorio, un ambicioso ejecutivo, es el encargado de supervisar el cierre de la empresa local. Pero, al llegar, es recibido con calidez y hospitalidad por los trabajadores de la empresa, especialmente por Erica, la directora de la planta, que cree que su intención es aumentar la producción. Poco a poco Gregorio se sumerge en la magia de la comunidad, comenzando a cuestionar sus propias lealtades y enamorándose del lugar y de Erica. Gregorio terminará enfrentando a su empresa para salvar a la embotelladora y a sus trabajadores y así ganarse el corazón de Erica.

programme.title: Amores Que Enganan
programme.desc: Mariana era una mujer profesionista e independiente, pero a raíz de su segundo matrimonio con Ricardo ella deja de trabajar y se vuelve totalmente dependiente económicamente de su esposo. Cuando esta situación pone en riesgo a sus hijos, Mariana toma fuerzas para confrontar a su marido y cambiar su vida.

programme.title: Escandalos - Un Gato Para Sarahil
programme.desc: Una joven criada en una estricta familia, apeada a las costumbres árabes, desea tener una mascota. Roba un cheque a su padre para comprarla. Aterrada al ser descubierta trata de recuperar el dinero. En la desesperación al no lograrlo termina matando a los jóvenes que le vendieron la mascota

programme.title: Escandalos - Batalla Embriones
programme.desc: Una famosa estrella de comedias televisivas, a punto de casarse con un famoso actor de cine, se debe enfrentar a su exmarido cuando este decide convertirse en padre soltero, usando embriones que ambos congelaron durante su matrimonio.

programme.title: Juntos Esta Navidad
programme.desc: Tras una ruptura amorosa, ISABEL decide alquilar una pequeña casita navideña en un apartado pueblito, para pasar la temporada decembrina trabajando en su libro. Pero el viudo JUAN ANDRÉS y su hija LAURITA han tenido la misma idea. Por un error les alquilan la misma casa. La zona está llena por la temporada y se ven obligados a compartir el lugar, en principio por una noche. Pero una serie de circunstancias hacen que la situación se alargue. La magia navideña hace de las suyas y, poco a poco, entre ISABEL y JUAN ANDRÉS surge una atracción muy especial.

programme.title: Intercambio Navideno
programme.desc: MAYA y ANA MARÍA son gemelas. Pero fueron separadas al nacer y entregadas a diferentes familias. Fueron criadas de maneras opuestas. ANA MARÍA es ahora una exitosa empresaria divorciada, que solo piensa en su éxito y en el trabajo. MAYA una incansable filántropa, criada por una familia que se dedica a trabajar en pro de los más necesitados. Ya adultas se descubren una a la otra y deciden guardar el secreto, para no hacer daño a sus familias. Pero una navidad deciden hacer la travesura de intercambiar sus vidas por una noche. Sin sospechar que aquella decisión las cambiará para siempre.

programme.title: La Mejor Navidad
programme.desc: Desde su divorcio, la ambiciosa Gloria ha dedicado todo su tiempo y su atención a su trabajo en Miami. Incluso sus hijos han pasado a un segundo plano. Cuando las circunstancias la obligan a pasar una navidad en familia en el rancho de su exmarido Eduardo en un pequeño pueblo de Jalisco, descubre que la felicidad y el amor suelen esconderse en las cosas más simples.

programme.title: Un Papa Para Navidad
programme.desc: Rebeca es una estrella de las redes. Se ha dejado encandilar de tal manera por la fama y el reconocimiento que su familia ha pasado a segundo plano. Pero una navidad un desconocido se presenta en su puerta afirmando que es su padre. Y aquel encuentro ayudará a Rebeca a recuperar lo verdaderamente importante en la vida.
